usedFor: Zoho Sign holds documents out for signature, and Dropbox stores the file through “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a recipient signs a document” in Zoho Sign, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A signed document is ready to file, so a copy lands in a chosen Dropbox folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public link, so pick add, replace or update for existing files.
